sharjbook.name: Sharjbook — Building Management Product Website
sharjbook.description: A publicly accessible work sample presenting product features, pricing and guides in a responsive Persian RTL interface.

sharjbook.challenge: Present product information in a responsive RTL interface and make pages accessible to search engines through prerendering, metadata, canonical URLs and structured data.
sharjbook.result: The website can be viewed at sharjbook.com as a public example of this frontend work.

kingrose.description: Remote ERP frontend development using React and Redux. Project started within Feb–Mar 2019.
kingrose.architecture: Reusable components organized through Atomic Design, with Redux state management, Formik forms, React Table and Bootstrap styling.
kingrose.challenge: Build ERP forms and data tables with reusable frontend components.
kingrose.result: Implemented ERP interfaces, forms and data tables for Kingrose+. No public project link is provided.

green.name: Green Electricity — Online Bill Payment Portal
green.description: Andishe Computer: an online electricity bill payment portal supporting the move away from paper bills. Started within Jun–Jul 2016.
green.architecture: Angular, TypeScript and Angular Material, with RxJS and NgRx data flows, Angular Universal and REST API integration.
green.challenge: Implement bill-payment interfaces and manage application data flows.
green.result: Developed the portal's frontend and API integration. No public project link is provided.

about.paragraphOne: I am a Senior Frontend Developer specializing in Angular, React and TypeScript. My work spans a broad range of business and product projects, from company websites to enterprise and utility systems. Sharjbook, remote development of Kingrose+ ERP in Turkey, and electricity Billing and Green Electricity payment portals are examples of that experience.
about.paragraphTwo: I focus on maintainable frontend architecture, reusable components and responsive interfaces. My toolkit includes Nx, Micro Frontends, Module Federation, RxJS, Signals, NgRx and Redux, alongside REST APIs, WebSocket, PWA, SSR, SEO and motion with reduced-motion support.
